text:
tara (oncall): heads up — getting an SLA alert from ACME for p99 on /v1/chat. They've got tail latency ~2s, p95 ~1.1s. No error rate spike. Anyone see anything in kernel land?
lisa (support): customer sent a trace: https://traces.internal/acme/trace/0a1b2c. They say issue started ~09:05 UTC.
metrics-bot: [alert] p99 latency for model=redwood-chat-3 increased from 420ms -> 1.9s at 09:06 UTC (route: hosted-us-west).
devon (sre): digging — I can see a config roll at 09:04 that toggled a compile flag and changed kernel heuristic to prefer SDPA for attn kernels. Commit d4f9f8. That timing matches. No infra scaling events.
zhou (ml-runtime): quick repro on staging with similar model/seqmix: enabling SDPA improved median but p99 regressed badly for sequences >1024. Likely an edge interaction with KV chunking + SDPA kernel. Repro commands:
```
# repro script (staging)
python tools/repro_latency.py --model redwood-chat-3 --seq_len 1536 --clients 8 --duration 60
# observed: p99 ~1.8s when sdpa enabled, 420ms when using flashattn path
```
devon (sre): ok mitigation plan: 1) rollback the compile flag on canary, 2) add a short-term kernel fallback rule: prefer flashattn for seq_len>1024, 3) run canary and monitor p99 for 30m. Can we flip those quickly?
tara (oncall): agree. lisa, can you tell the customer we're investigating and ETA ~25m for mitigation?
lisa (support): on it — messaging now: "We're seeing a kernel heuristic change; rolling back and applying fallbacks, ETA ~25m. Will follow up when p99 improves." :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: starting rollback job for commit d4f9f8 -> previous stable abc123. Job ID: deploy-7821.
devon (sre): rollback applied on canary at 09:20 UTC, and I pushed a routing override: 
```
PATCH /admin/v1/model-config/redwood-chat-3
{ "attn_kernel_preference": [{"cond": "seq_len>1024", "prefer": "flashattn"} ] }
```
metrics-bot: post-deploy snapshot (canary): p50=380ms p95=540ms p99=610ms (down from p99=1.9s).
zhou (ml-runtime): nice. I'll open an issue to add long-sequence perf unit tests and a dedicated regression test for SDPA vs flashattn interaction. Filing: https://issues.internal/AI-783
devon (sre): follow-ups: - tighten kernel selection heuristics, - add canary check that exercises seq_len>1024. I'll put up a PR for the rollback automation to include a fallback rule generator.
tara (oncall): thanks everyone. lisa — please send a status update to ACME with timeline and note that we applied a kernel heuristic rollback and a seq_len fallback; offer to re-run their failed workload after we validate.
lisa (support): done. customer replied "thanks, we'll watch".
metrics-bot: alert cleared for p99 at 09:29 UTC.
tara (oncall): marking incident mitigated. assigning action items: zhou (add tests), devon (kernel heuristics PR), lisa (confirm with customer tomorrow). Closing the oncall thread unless new regressions appear.
